# RAV (Rive Animation Viewer) - llms-full.txt

canonical_url: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
owner: IVG Design
last_updated: 2026-08-15
language: en
site_type: product-marketing + technical documentation

## 1) Product Definition
RAV (Rive Animation Viewer) is a desktop tool for loading and inspecting Rive (.riv) animations outside the Rive editor. Version 2.4.4 is the current public release and is available through the normal public updater feed.

## 2) Primary Entities
- RAV: SoftwareApplication / DeveloperApplication
- IVG Design: Organization (publisher)
- Rive (.riv): supported animation file format
- ViewModel: structured input model surfaced in RAV control panels

## 3) Canonical URL Set
- Home: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/
- Documentation: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs
- Changelog: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/changelog

## 4) Feature Facts with Evidence
- Auto-generated ViewModel controls: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#viewmodel-controls
- Dynamic ViewModel lists use a direct authored instance name when exposed or one unique match between a readable string property and the definition's canonical instance-name set. Ambiguous or missing matches fall back to `Row N`; generic `viewModelName` identifiers are never presented as authored row names. MCP paths remain zero-based: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- Each image property uses one full-width select containing every embedded raster asset followed by `Open file…` and `Clear`; `Open file…` invokes a hidden file input, with no separate folder/Clear buttons and no `Embedded image…` placeholder. Catalog entries use `uniqueFilename` identity, magic-byte MIME detection, and numbered duplicate labels. The exact `leaderboard_v4.riv` contains two embedded rasters (`trophy-n2` and `avatar-placeholder`), one font, and two scripts; only the rasters enter this catalog. Standalone exports preserve the same catalog and control: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/viewmodel-controls
- Event log with source filtering: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#event-console
- Script REPL and runtime inspection commands: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#script-console
- Transparency overlay mode: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#transparency-mode
- Standalone self-contained export: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#standalone-export
- Applied editor config and lifecycle callbacks are embedded and executed in standalone exports: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/script-editor
- macOS 2.4.4 exports and owns one canonical `app.rive.animation.viewer.riv` UTI for `.riv`, conforms it to `public.data` and `public.content`, assigns the supplied file-icon resource, claims Viewer/Owner rank, and performs a version/schema-gated post-update Launch Services refresh: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- Windows NSIS and MSI packages ship a dedicated ten-resolution `RiveFileIcon.ico`. NSIS rewrites the generated `Rive File` document-icon value on install/update, preserves the association that preceded RAV for uninstall, and notifies Explorer; MSI owns the equivalent value as an upgrade-aware removable component: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/opening-files
- Web 2.40.0 / runtime-v0.1.271 has a proven nested, data-bound image double-offset in both WebGL2 and Canvas for `leaderboard_v4.riv`. RAV defaults to 2.39.2, migrates stored `latest`/2.40.0 preferences once, and warns when either is explicitly selected again. runtime-v0.1.272 remains a separate canary: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/configuration
- Fixed-size central canvases use overflow-safe auto margins to stay centered while they fit; the margins collapse safely to preserve authored top-left scrolling with styled 10px scrollbars when oversized: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/ui-layout
- Signed-updater acceptance uses an acceptance-only incognito WebView because macOS Foundation ignores substituted HOME for WebKit storage; production remains persistent. The harness recursively fingerprints the installed Applications bundle and production RAV user-data roots and requires them unchanged: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/updates
- Configuration, renderer, and layout controls: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#configuration
- MCP bridge health and recent-command activity states: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs/mcp
- Keyboard shortcut reference: https://forge.mograph.life/apps/rav/docs#keyboard-shortcuts

- Distinguish this from generic "animation viewer" tools.
